visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of five friends stands in the middle of a brightly lit Kaohsiung night market street. Nana, wearing a green tank top, waves energetically while the others smile at the camera. The background is dense with food stall signs and a large crowd of people. (2) A food vendor in a tan vest waves enthusiastically from behind his stall. On the counter, trays of dark-colored cooked duck parts and organs are visible under the bright fluorescent stall lighting. (3) The group huddles together as they use thin wooden skewers to pick pieces of food from a small plastic bag. They are shown in a medium-full shot with the vibrant street life of the market continuing behind them. (4) The scene shifts to the group members trying the food, with close-ups of Sam looking hesitant and then reacting to the flavor. Their facial expressions are animated and expressive. (5) On a large flat metal griddle, a chef in a red shirt vigorously tosses and fries a large portion of rice with eggs and meat. The steam rises as he uses a metal spatula to mix the ingredients quickly. (6) The friends are seen sharing a cardboard box of the fried rice. One of the women uses a white plastic spoon to take a large bite while her friends watch and comment, surrounded by the busy night market atmosphere. (7) Nana is shown in a close-up, walking through the market and jokingly pretending to sneak food from another stall. Colorful signage for 'Coffin Bread' is visible in the background. (8) The group sits at a crowded outdoor table where plates of 'Coffin Bread'—thick fried bread filled with creamy soup—are being served and sliced with knives. (9) A Japanese couple joins the scene, holding a 360-degree camera on a stick. They are shown trying pieces of stinky tofu with chopsticks while Nana and her friends observe their reactions. (10) A man named Louis wearing a white baseball cap is shown taking a large bite of food and giving a thumbs-up to the camera with an impressed expression. (11) The video concludes with the entire group standing in front of a juice stall, each holding a cup of orange-colored papaya milk and drinking together.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice greeting the audience over an upbeat synthesizer BGM with a consistent 4/4 rhythm. Background noise includes loud market chatter and laughter. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect marks a visual transition to the food stall owner. The BGM remains energetic while a male voice engages in fast-paced conversational speech. (3) Auditory details include the distinct crinkling of plastic food bags and the light clatter of skewers. Multiple voices from the group overlap in a chaotic but joyful way, indicating high arousal. (4) A digital 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the focus moves to the fried rice stall. The BGM ducks slightly to allow the sizzling sound of a hot griddle to become prominent. (5) One group member uses Cantonese phrases to describe the rice, providing a shift in vocal timbre and language while the music continues its steady tempo. (6) A comical cartoon sound effect emphasizes a funny facial expression. The narration continues with high pitch variability, expressing excitement about the variety of snacks available. (7) Group chatter intensifies with loud, multi-layered laughter and high-valence exclamations as they sit down to eat 'Coffin Bread'. (8) The acoustic profile changes as Japanese voices are heard; the tone is curious and slightly uncertain, accompanied by persistent background market murmurs. (9) Loud, projected exclamations of 'Umai!' and 'Delicious!' from male voices dominate the track, followed by a final, triumphant musical stinger as the BGM fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Series of Food Trials -> Cultural Interaction -> Final Summary
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase the diverse and famous food culture of Kaohsiung's Liuhe Night Market by bringing international friends (from Hong Kong and Japan) to try local specialties, capturing their genuine and humorous reactions.

high_inference.freeDescribe: This is a high-energy social media vlog characterized by rapid cuts, vibrant night market visuals, and multi-lingual reactions. It emphasizes cross-cultural food experiences.
